description.en: The instance ID of the data migration, synchronization, or subscribe instance.
The ID of the data migration, synchronization, or change tracking task.

description.zh:
DTS实例的任务类型，取值：

- **MIGRATION**：迁移。
- **SYNC**：同步。
- **SUBSCRIBE**：订阅。
description.en:
The node type of the DTS instance. Valid values:

- **MIGRATION**: data migration.
- **SYNC**: data synchronization.
- **SUBSCRIBE**: change tracking.

description.zh: 数据迁移或同步实例所在地域的id，详情请参见[支持的地域列表](~~141033~~)。
description.en: The ID of the region where the data migration or synchronization instance resides. For more information, see [List of supported regions](~~141033~~).

description.zh: 特殊业务专用字段，无需传参。
description.en: A special business-specific field. You do not need to pass this parameter.

description.zh:
同步方向，取值：
- **Forward**：正向。
- **Reverse**：反向。

> - 默认取值为**Forward**。
- 当数据同步实例的拓扑为双向时，才可以传入**Reverse**以释放反向同步链路。
description.en:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:
- **Forward**: forward.
- **Reverse**: reverse.

> - Default value: **Forward**.
- You can set this parameter to **Reverse** to release the reverse synchronization link only if the topology of the data synchronization instance is two-way synchronization.

description.zh: 特殊业务专用字段，无需传参。
description.en: A special business-specific field. You do not need to pass this parameter.

descriptions.zh: > <props="china"><ph>包年包月的DTS实例不支持通过API释放，您可以通过退订的方式进行释放。更多信息，请参见[释放DTS实例](~~289054~~)。</ph></props><props="intl"><ph>包年包月的DTS实例不支持释放。</ph></props>
descriptions.en: > <props="china"><ph>Subscription DTS instances cannot be released by calling this API operation. You can release them by unsubscribing. For more information, see [Release a DTS instance](~~289054~~).</ph></props><props="intl"><ph>Subscription DTS instances cannot be released.</ph></props>.
